scientific_role: independent native-model topology gate anticipated before any Jacobian-pole or chi_bio construction; it does not overwrite the finite-window Figure 8 adjudication
parameter_cases: same Figure 8 A/B/C parameter copies frozen in JARUS_FIG8_EXECUTION_FREEZE_v0_2.json

root_search.solver: MATLAB fsolve in log-state coordinates so every candidate state is positive
root_search.fixed_seed_definition: each listed scalar is used for all six state components
root_search.multiple_physical_roots: preserve all distinct accepted positive roots and mark paper-level single-equilibrium correspondence INDETERMINATE rather than selecting one post hoc

jacobian.method: central finite differences of the pinned reduced RHS at each accepted TR=1 equilibrium
jacobian.classification: STABLE only if max(real(eigenvalues)) < 0 at all three step multipliers; UNSTABLE only if > 0 at all three; otherwise INDETERMINATE_NUMERICAL_SIGN

case_adjudication.FIG8A_NOMINAL_DAMPED: paper local-stability claim PASS only if exactly one distinct accepted positive root is found and it is STABLE
case_adjudication.FIG8B_LIMIT_CYCLE: paper local-stability claim PASS only if exactly one distinct accepted positive root is found and it is UNSTABLE
case_adjudication.FIG8C_RELAXATION_OSCILLATION: paper local-stability claim PASS only if exactly one distinct accepted positive root is found and it is UNSTABLE

next_gate_if_local_stability_claims_pass: freeze a separate limit-cycle/return-geometry gate for B/C and representation-sensitivity audit before any scalar construction
forbidden_inference: Local equilibrium stability alone does not prove a stable limit cycle and does not license chi_bio.
